artworks.title: Plate 24. Castle Rock, Green River Valley
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image features a calm river winding through a rugged landscape. Closest to the viewer are low shrubs and a person standing in the shallow water. A large rock formation dominates the left side of the image, with distant hills visible on the right. The horizon is low in the image, with a clear sky and an earthy color palette of browns, tans, and grays reflecting on the river's surface.

artworks.title: Plate 25. Green River Valley, Looking Down the River
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape beside a river. The river flows from the left and curves towards the horizon. Sparse vegetation covers low hills beneath the high horizon. Along the riverbank are dense bushes, wild grass, and a line of tall trees standing to the right. The scene has a warm sepia tone.

artworks.title: Plate 26. Church Buttes
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a large, rugged rock formation. The horizon is not prominent. The land gently rises towards the base of the formation. A telegraph pole stands to the left. The rock layers show natural striations. The color palette includes earthy browns and grays. The sky above is empty. Desert vegetation is visible on the rough terrain.

artworks.title: Plate 27. Supply Trains
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a convoy of horse-drawn covered wagons moving towards the right side, where a group of steam locomotives from the U.P.R.R. (Union Pacific Railroad) line the railway tracks. The horizon lies high in the frame, with the terrain gently rising and falling in the distance, marked by sparse vegetation and rolling hills. The focus of the photograph is on the mix of transportation methods, with the detailed figures of people, horses, and wagons sharing the space with the trains. The image is monochrome, with a sepia tone that adds an antique quality, highlighting the textures of the earth, the rails, and the materials of the wagons and trains. This palette, along with the sharp focus and slightly blurred motion of the horses closest to us, emphasizes the historical and dynamic nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Plate 28. Coal Beds of Bear River
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a steep, rocky hill or mountain with a clear or slightly overcast sky at the top. A wooden structure or railing is partially visible at the bottom edge. Several individuals are near a dark opening in the hillside, likely the entrance to a tunnel or mine, with piles of earth nearby. The landscape features large rock formations and sparse vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones.

artworks.title: Plate 29. Bear River City, near the Coal Fields
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a historical photograph of a settlement in a mountainous area. It features a dirt pathway lined with wooden structures and tents. Hills with sparse vegetation are seen in the background. The closest structures are made of logs and timber, with one building showing a sign that reads "RESTAURANT." A person stands at the entrance. More wooden buildings and commercial signs can be seen further along the path. The color palette is earthy with browns and grays, typical of sepia-toned photography. The composition leads the eye along the path to where the settlement merges with the landscape.

artworks.title: Plate 30. Looking Down Echo Canon, from Death's Rock
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon close to the center, featuring a towering cliff on the right side. A winding dirt path curves around the base of the cliff and disappears into the distance, with a person walking along it. The color palette includes earthy tones like sepia and brown. In the background, there are rolling hills fading into the sky. The composition balances the rock formation on the right with the open space on the left.

artworks.title: Plate 31. Monument Rock, Mouth of Echo Canon
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large rock formation against a clear sky, with a horizon on the right side where sparse vegetation is visible. The rock has layers and weathered surfaces, indicating geological history. The color palette is muted earth tones of brown and beige. The foreground has grassy terrain, contrasting with the rocky landscape beyond the formation.

artworks.title: Plate 32. Hanging Rock, Foot of Echo Canon
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on rocky terrain near two textured rock formations. In the background, there is a small settlement with a few buildings and a river curving through the landscape. Distant hills partially obscure the horizon. The image has a vintage black and white style with a sepia tone, emphasizing brown and gray tones.

artworks.title: Plate 33. Sphynx of the Valley
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large boulder perched on earth and rock. In the background, there are hills on either side, a river winding through the scene, and a curved horizon. The color scheme is mainly monochrome, adding emphasis to textures and shapes. Shadows and light create depth and contrast in the landscape.

artworks.title: Plate 34. Sentinel Rock, Weber Valley
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rocky, rugged formation dominating the left side of the scene. The viewpoint is from a lower perspective, looking upward towards the rock mound. A horizon is visible where the base of the rock formation meets the ground. On the right, there is a distinct rock formation resembling a smaller pedestal or balanced rock against a clear sky. The ground is uneven and scattered with rocks and debris, with wooden fences running across. A lone figure, appearing to be a man kneeling, is positioned to the right of the center. The overall tonal palette of the image is sepia, enhancing the textures of the rock surface.

artworks.title: Plate 35. Echo City, Looking Up Weber River
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a winding river flowing through a valley between hills. The view is elevated, offering a broad perspective of the scene. Closest to us, the riverbank is rocky with sparse vegetation, leading to a steep bank that meets the hills. On one side, leafless trees line the riverbank. On the other side, buildings are visible on a cliff slope. The horizon is low, with hills gradually rising towards the top of the image. The photograph features a sepia color palette, accentuating the natural beauty of the landscape. The composition captures the river's journey through the isolated terrain.

artworks.title: Plate 36. Coalville, Weber Valley
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a settlement from an elevated viewpoint. A dirt road leads into the distance past wooden structures like houses and barns arranged in an organized pattern with wooden fences. A white building stands out among the structures. The horizon is dominated by a rugged hillside. Fields and trees are visible in the distance. The scene has a sepia tone, showing detailed shadows indicating angled sunlight. A group of people is seen on a slope in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Plate 37. Willhelmina Pass, from the East
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a river winding between rocky hills. The river flows from right to left and the horizon is low. The hills on both sides taper off in the distance. One hill on the left has a vertical cliff face. The scene has earthy tones, mainly browns and sepia. Near the riverbank, there is shrubbery, and further into the scene, the vegetation becomes more sparse, interspersed with rocky outcrops. The distant hills have a rough texture.

artworks.title: Plate 38. Rock Great Eastern
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with a large rocky outcrop on the left side. The viewpoint is from a lower position looking up towards the rock under a clear sky. The horizon is not clearly visible, as the terrain slopes upwards from the bottom right of the image towards the central rock formation. The rock's surface shows horizontal stratifications and some vegetation. Nearby, there are dry shrubs and sparse grasses. In the distance, the landscape continues to rise with an old wooden fence line. The image is in sepia tones highlighting the earth tones and sunlight, which appears to come from off-camera.

artworks.title: Plate 39. East End of Tunnel, Weber Canon
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a railway track leading towards a tunnel entrance carved into a rocky cliff face. The horizon is partially obscured by rock formations and trees. There are no brushstrokes, indicating it is a photograph. Rocky terrain surrounds the tracks with scattered stones. In the distance, a group of individuals is gathered near the tunnel entrance. More people are seen closer to the tunnel across different elevations of the rocky cliff. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of brown and gray.

artworks.title: Plate 40. Devil's Gate, Weber Canon
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow canyon with towering rock walls on both sides. The viewpoint is from the base of the canyon, looking towards the opening that reveals distant hills and mountains. The horizon is high in the image, showing snow-dusted, tree-covered mountain tops against a pale sky. The rocks in the foreground are rugged with rough textures and jagged edges, contrasting with the softer contours of the hills beyond. The color palette is muted sepia, giving the scene a timeless and monochromatic quality. The canyon walls capture shadows and light, enhancing the depth and texture of the rocky surfaces.

artworks.title: Plate 41. Weber Canon, from below Devil's Gate
artworks.dimensions:
image/sheet: 21 × 28 cm (8 1/4 × 11 in.)
page size: 32.4 × 46 cm (12 3/4 × 18 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rugged mountain landscape with a river flowing from right to left. The view is dominated by the sloping mountain sides and the deep valley carved out by the river. In the foreground, a rocky path winds along the mountainside with several figures and pack animals lined up. The scene is captured in sepia tone, giving it an antique feel. The rocks and flowing water are clear, showing a contrast between the textures. The mountains in the distance gradually fade, adding depth.

artworks.title: Plate 42. Mormon Turnpike Bridge, Mouth of Weber Canon
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden bridge over a river, with mountains on both sides. The mountains are covered with snow and the color scheme is predominantly sepia. In the foreground, the river flows smoothly, reflecting light. Leafless branches extend into the scene from the right. Near the bridge, there is a small cabin and two figures.

artworks.title: Plate 43. Weber Valley, from Willhelmina Pass
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river flowing through it. Rocky ground lines the left riverbank where a person is sitting or crouching. A large tree is on the right, with mountains in the distance. The sky is expansive above. The color scheme is sepia, giving an antique feel. The image is a photograph capturing details like water ripples and tree foliage.

artworks.title: Plate 44. General Casement's Construction Train
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a steam train viewed from a low vantage point. The train moves from right to left, with men standing along the tracks. The horizon is high in the image, with a focus on the train and the individuals. The vintage image lacks a distinct brushstroke style, featuring a limited brown color palette. The train in the distance diminishes in detail towards the left edge, highlighting its length. The foreground has an uneven dirt and rock surface.

artworks.title: Plate 45. Salt Lake City, from the Top of the Tabernacle
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: This image depicts a town surrounded by mountains. The town contains various buildings, construction materials, carriages, and unpaved streets. The monochrome color palette adds a vintage aesthetic. Trees are scattered throughout the town, contrasting with the buildings. In the background, large mountains loom over the settlement.

artworks.title: Plate 46. City Creek Canon, near City Creek Falls
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated point of view, capturing a mountainous terrain. The horizon is obscured by the mountain slopes. A waterfall cascades down a rocky hillside, creating a mist-like effect where the water flows. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia and brown. Snow covers rocks and tree branches in the foreground, with sparse vegetation and exposed roots adding texture to the ground. In the distance, trees climb up the slopes.

artworks.title: Plate 47. Residence of Brigham Young
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a bird's eye view of a tree-lined street with architectural structures. There are mature trees and a path leading to buildings. To the right, there is a house with shutters and a fenced garden. Further away, there is a larger building with a unique roofline. In the background, there are mountains with a range of peaks and valleys. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving a vintage feel. The image is detailed and sharp, highlighting textures and shapes.
